facts.text: Southern Miss houses the oldest honors college in Mississippi and sixth-oldest in the nation, offering scholarship support to every admitted honors student.

sources.title: Undergraduate Admissions - Freshmen | Undergraduate Admissions | The University of Southern Mississippi
sources.quote: The University's prestigious Honors College is the sixth-oldest acceptance-based honors college in the nation and the oldest in Mississippi.

sources.title: Undergraduate Admissions - Freshmen | Undergraduate Admissions | The University of Southern Mississippi
sources.quote: Every student in the Honors College receives scholarship support.
